name: Dinevi Group
hybrid_detail: Real-estate developer, hotel operator (Palace Hotel, Mirage Hotel Burgas), yacht marina operator (Marina Dinevi) and general contractor (built Burgas Free University, Arena Amphitheatre).
physical_exposure_evidence: Operates 40+ built holiday complexes, Palace boutique hotel, Mirage Hotel in Burgas, Marina Dinevi yacht port (capacity ~250 boats), Arena Amphitheatre (800 seats) and rents 250+ retail units within Dinevi Resort, Sveti Vlas.
price_evidence: Self-describes as 'the first company in Bulgaria to build closed-type luxury holiday settlements, positioning itself in the luxurious segment of the real estate market'; hosts Summer Fashion Weekend and White Party luxury lifestyle events at Marina Dinevi.
key_messages: Founded 1989 by Dinko and Yordan Dinev; 35+ years turning Sveti Vlas into an elite Balkan resort
Vertically integrated: development, construction, hotel and marina operation, event production and even agriculture under one holding
Zero unfinished complexes claimed across 30+ years of delivery — strong reliability narrative for premium material partners
summary: Pioneer Bulgarian resort developer that built and now operates the large-scale Dinevi Resort in Sveti Vlas (40+ closed-type holiday complexes, hotels, marina, amphitheatre). Highest physical exposure and prescription potential of the Sunny Beach/Sveti Vlas cluster given its scale and vertical integration.

name: AMK STROY

physical_exposure_evidence: Own project website with active sales office contact; no dedicated showroom or material display confirmed.
price_evidence: Marketing copy emphasizes 'НАЙ-ВИСОК КЛАС ИЗПЪЛНЕНИЕ' (highest-class execution), first-line sea location, panoramic terraces; apartments delivered turnkey with laminate and granite-tile (гранитогрес) flooring and fully finished bathrooms.
key_messages: Active multi-project pipeline in Nessebar: Amira Sea Residence, Roca Grande, Roca Park, Roca Residence 1&2, Villa Roca 1-6, Black Sea 1&2, La Vista Boutique House
First-line sea developments delivered turnkey ('до ключ')
New construction of Amira Sea Residence (3 buildings, first line, 3 pools) starting December 2025
summary: Nessebar-based developer/contractor with a dense, recurring pipeline of mid-to-high-end residential complexes on the New Town waterfront. Amira Sea Residence (construction starting Dec 2025) is its flagship current project and a concrete near-term opportunity to be specified during finishes phase.

name: Green Life Development & Resorts
physical_exposure_evidence: Operates hotel resorts and holiday complexes under the Green Life Resorts brand; award-winning built projects (Paradise View Holiday Complex, Park 'Aivazovski') actively managed and marketed.
address: Kavatsi / Budzhaka area, near Sozopol, Burgas Province, Bulgaria
price_evidence: 25-year-old investment company presented as market leader; won 'Best Development – Bulgaria', 'Superbrand' and 'Building of the Year' awards; positions itself around ecological construction and high-quality materials.
key_messages: 25 years of history, leading position in the Bulgarian holiday-property market
Green Life Beach Resort: ~120-acre gated resort on the Kavatsi-Smokinya beach near Sozopol, sold in multiple phases (one 'First Line' block reported sold out)
Award-winning: Best Development Bulgaria, Superbrand, Building of the Year
summary: One of the most established investment/developer groups on the southern Black Sea coast, with Green Life Beach Resort as its landmark Sozopol project plus a separate hotel-resorts division. Strong prescription target given long-term reinvestment cycles (repeat phases) and award-driven premium positioning.

name: Prime Developments Co

summary: One of the broadest active developer portfolios spanning BOTH the coast (Sunny Beach, Sveti Vlas, Sozopol) and the mountain (Bansko), making it a high-value single point of contact for a national tourism-projects push. Post-completion management role also gives ongoing renovation/refurbishment potential.

name: Grand Resort Pamporovo
hybrid_detail: Design/construction company plus hospitality operator: manages Pamporovo's largest bed-base (95,000 sqm, 1,000+ beds) and separately invests in photovoltaic parks.

price_evidence: Uses natural materials (travertine, wood) for an 'elegant mountain look'; positioned as rental-yield investment product managed by the company's own hospitality arm rather than as ultra-luxury one-off units.
key_messages: 120,000+ sqm built across Smolyan, Pamporovo, Sofia and Sunny Beach — a genuinely multi-region construction group
Owns/operates the largest hotel bed-base in Pamporovo (1,000+ beds) alongside its own residential sections
New Section G construction started March 2025; Section F already delivered with Act 16
summary: The single strongest, most current Pamporovo lead: an active developer/contractor with live construction (Section G), direct sales contact, and a stated preference for natural stone-like materials (travertine) in finishes — a natural conversation opener for Dekton/Silestone.
